jobDescription:
Lead Infrastructure Engineer — Diriyah Gate

The Diriyah Gate Development Authority is seeking a Lead Infrastructure Engineer to oversee utilities, road networks, and smart-city systems for one of Saudi Arabia's most iconic heritage-led developments.

Requirements:
• 8+ years in civil/infrastructure engineering with large mixed-use projects
• Proven experience with PIF or giga-project environments (NEOM, ROSHN, Diriyah, Qiddiya)
• Deep knowledge of Saudi Building Code, ASHRAE, and sustainability standards
• Hands-on with BIM, digital twins, and smart-city IoT integration
• Strong stakeholder management with government and private partners
• Fluency in Arabic and English
• Master's degree in Civil Engineering or equivalent

Responsibilities:
• Design and supervise road, utility, and smart-grid infrastructure
• Align all engineering outputs with Vision 2030 sustainability targets
• Lead a multidisciplinary team of 15+ engineers and contractors
• Report directly to the Program Director on milestones and risks
